# package official

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-iec61850-model/official"
```

Package official embeds the IEC 61850 information model of the official IEC NSD packages tracked by this module, so that programs can look up classes, data objects, CDCs and types, resolve references and describe measurements without downloading or loading any IEC file.

	p, err := official.Default() // IEC 61850-7-2, 7-3, 7-4, 7-410, 7-420
	res, err := resolver.New(p).ResolveString("LD0/MMXU1.Hz.mag.f[MX]")
	d, err := semantic.Describe(p, "MMXU.PNV.phsA")

The embedded data (catalog\_gen.json.gz, declared in catalog\_gen.go) is generated from the packages pinned in sources/nsd.lock.json with "make nsd-publish"; catalog\_gen.json holds the same data indented, for review, and is not embedded. Do not edit them. They are derived from IEC code components and published under the IEC Code Components license: see NOTICE.md in this directory for the attribution, license and copyright notices.

#### Profiles {#hdr-Profiles}

The catalog holds every NSD release IEC publishes: 7-2, 7-3 and 7-4 from 2007A2 to 2007B6, 90-6 2018A5 and 2018B, and one release of each other part. Definitions keep their namespace. Three profiles are embedded:

  - default: the newest releases of IEC 61850-7-2, 7-3, 7-4, 7-410 and 7-420, the preferred sources for current models. Lookups are unambiguous except FSCH, which IEC 61850-7-410 redefines (as a deprecated class).
  - extended: the default profile plus the technical reports 90-3, 90-4, 90-6, 90-9, 90-11, 90-14 and 90-21. IEC TR 61850-90-9 defines DBAT, DSTO, SBAT and storage base classes that IEC 61850-7-420 took over; such names are ambiguous unqualified and are looked up with their namespace (catalog LogicalNodeIn, resolver In).
  - edition2: IEC 61850-7-2, 7-3 and 7-4 at 2007A3, Edition 2, for devices that declare IEC 61850-7-4:2007 or 2007A.

[ForNamespace](#func-fornamespace) names the profile for the release a device declares in LLN0.NamPlt.ldNs; any other release can be selected by ID with Catalog().Profile. Definitions are never merged; catalog Overlaps compares definitions that share a name.

## Functions

### func Catalog

```go
func Catalog() (*catalog.Catalog, error)
```

Catalog returns the catalog of every embedded namespace. It is parsed once and shared; it is immutable and safe for concurrent use.

### func Default

```go
func Default() (*catalog.Profile, error)
```

Default returns the default profile: IEC 61850-7-2, 7-3, 7-4, 7-410 and 7-420. IEC 61850-7-420 is the source for current DER and storage models.

### func Extended

```go
func Extended() (*catalog.Profile, error)
```

Extended returns the default profile plus the technical reports. Names a report defines again (e.g. DBAT in IEC TR 61850-90-9 and IEC 61850-7-420) are ambiguous in it; look them up with their namespace.

### func Namespaces

```go
func Namespaces() []model.NamespaceID
```

Namespaces returns the IDs of the embedded namespaces, in order.

### func Notice

```go
func Notice() string
```

Notice returns the attribution, license and copyright notice of every embedded namespace (NOTICE.md). Software that redistributes the catalog must retain it.

### func Open

```go
func Open(name string) (*catalog.Profile, error)
```

Open returns the catalog profile of the named profile, built once and shared.

## Types

### type Profile

```go
type Profile struct {
	// Name is the profile name, e.g. "default" or "extended".
	Name string
	// Description says what the profile contains.
	Description string
	// Parts are the IEC parts of the profile, e.g. "7-420".
	Parts []string
	// Namespaces are the embedded namespace releases of the parts.
	Namespaces []model.NamespaceID
}
```

Profile is a named selection of the embedded namespaces.

#### func ForNamespace

```go
func ForNamespace(s string) (Profile, error)
```

ForNamespace returns the embedded profile to check a device against that declares namespace s, as LLN0.NamPlt.ldNs or a logical node's lnNs does, e.g. "IEC 61850-7-4:2007B" or "IEC 61850-7-4:2007A".

The profile must hold a release of the declared standard with the declared version, the declared revision when there is one, and at least the declared release; of several, the highest release wins, then the first profile in [Profiles](#func-profiles) order. A declaration without a revision ("IEC 61850-7-4:2007") selects the oldest embedded revision of that version, the edition it was first published as. Standards are compared without spaces and technical-report markers, so "IEC TR 61850-90-9" finds "(Tr)IEC 61850-90-9".

It fails with [model.ErrUnknownNamespace](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec61850-model/model#ErrUnknownNamespace) when no embedded profile holds a matching release, e.g. for "IEC 61850-7-4:2003": IEC publishes no NSD for Edition 1 of IEC 61850-7-4.

#### func Lookup

```go
func Lookup(name string) (Profile, bool)
```

Lookup returns the definition of the named profile.

#### func Profiles

```go
func Profiles() []Profile
```

Profiles returns the named profiles, in the order of sources/index.json.
